email.body1:
Matt, saw Merlyn won a CES 2026 Top Innovation Award and expanded the teacher AI assistant into 48 Irish schools.

Expanding into new markets that fast usually means more districts and schools in play than the team can reach, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Merlyn off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matt, quick follow-up for Merlyn.

With the CES win and international expansion, the pipeline target probably grew faster than the team can. Most sales leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Merlyn needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matt, last bit of proof for Merlyn.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Merlyn's reply rate likely compares to peer edtech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matt, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know an international expansion keeps a sales calendar packed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Merlyn's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
